# `mise project init`

- **Usage:** `mise project init [FLAGS] [PATH]`
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/project/init.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/project/init.rs)

Create a new project scaffold

Writes a mise.toml (in PATH, default the current directory) declaring the
requested runtimes and package pins. Never touches code files.

## Arguments
- **`[PATH]`** — Directory to scaffold; created when missing

## Flags
- **`--python <PYTHON>`** — Declare a python runtime with an exact version
- **`--node <NODE>`** — Declare a node runtime with an exact version
- **`--package <ECO+NAME@VERSION>`** — Package pin like python+numpy@1.26.4 (eco + NAME@VERSION)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
